label: Leboncoin Scraper
title: Leboncoin Scraper: leboncoin.fr Listings to JSON & CSV
metaDescription: Scrape any leboncoin.fr search URL: price, location, seller, photos and every category attribute (surface, rooms, energy rating, mileage, fuel).
intro: Paste any leboncoin.fr search link and get each ad's price, location, seller, photos and every category-specific attribute, such as surface, rooms and energy rating for property, or mileage and fuel for cars.
useCases: Track second-hand car prices in France
Watch new property ads in a city
Research resale prices for a product category

faq.q: Can I use my own leboncoin search?
faq.a: Yes. Set your filters on leboncoin.fr (category, location, price, property type, rooms, surface, energy rating, fuel, gearbox, mileage…) and paste the search link.
All of them: real estate, cars, jobs and every other category, with each category's own attributes.

faq.q: Can I get every page of a search?
faq.a: Yes. The scraper pages through the whole search, and several links can run in one go.

faq.q: Can I tell professional from private sellers?
faq.a: Yes. Each ad says whether the seller is a professional or a private person.

faq.q: Do I need a leboncoin account?
faq.a: No. It reads public search results; no login or cookies.

officialApi: leboncoin has no public API for searching ads; its partner APIs are for professional advertisers posting their own listings. This actor returns the ads any visitor sees, with every category attribute.
